name: Kitty Andersen Youth Science Center (high school program)
what_you_do: High schoolers work as paid museum employees in a program built to feel like a real workplace. They pick from four STEM areas and get advising, portfolio help, college visits and career fairs.
who_can_apply: High school students in grades 9 to 12. The page lists ages 15 to 18 for the high school stage. The page says the youth pathway starts in middle school.
pay_detail: Paid as museum employees; the hourly rate is not stated on the page.
deadline_text: No application dates are posted on the page.
how_to_apply: The page does not describe how to apply. Contact the museum at info@smm.org or 651-221-9444 and ask about the Kitty Andersen Youth Science Center.
notes: The season, hours and how to apply are not stated. Check before you plan. There are four STEM areas. They are biological sciences and public health, media and technology, environmental sciences and sustainability, and engineering and design. The work permit rule was not checked.
